phone: Scout4All runs on computers: open this page on your PC or Mac.

macos.title: Mac
macos.requirements: Every Mac, with Apple or Intel chip
macos.help: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.

linux.title: Linux
linux.requirements: Not sure which one? It's almost always Intel or AMD.
linux.help: Extract the archive and run ./scout4all from a terminal.
